The '''Imperial Era''' began in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]] (12,689 Tapani calendar) and ended in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] (112,724 Tapani calendar). It was the period of time when [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] established the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[House Pelagia]] was [[Mecetti Purge|purged]] of its House [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Due to the year the Imperial Era began in, it was not aligned with the formal [[Declaration of a New Order]].<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
